report.speaker: Fabio Martinelli
report.title: Kinetically Constrained Spin Models: A Short Survey
report.question: 平衡测度只是独立 Bernoulli 乘积时，局部空位约束为何仍产生极慢松弛，而稳定方向又怎样预测二维时间尺度？
report.reading_scope:
martinelli-icm2026: Entire publisher HTML mathematical body §§1–4, every displayed formula and both figure captions, acknowledgments, footnotes and full bibliography [1]–[65], in overlapping section-sized reads. Body lines 87–553; footnotes 557–573; references 574–929; metadata/license 932–976. No full PDF or figure-pixel inspection. The third-party Figure 3.2 is not reproduced.
mst-one-facilitated-v1: Abstract and §§1.1–1.4; §2 main statements through Conjecture 3 (HTML lines 41–236), including Corollary 2.9 and Theorems 2.10/2.12. Selected §2.1 entropy-proof paragraphs and the start of §2.2 were read through approximately line 340; these sections and the whole paper were not read in full.
local-calculations: Finite-state probability/energy identities, elementary closure and geometry arguments, finite-graph duality and conditional log-scale calculations are proved in the authored notes; existing forest definitions supply the prerequisite vocabulary.

4G01.scope: 有限连续时间链、均匀化与矩阵指数；有限求和证明详细平衡推出平稳。

4G02.scope: 局部有限乘积空间中的热浴平均和条件方差；双副本平方差恒等式直接展开。

4G03.scope: 更新族、Poisson 尝试与有限边界生成元；以 M=|union U| 计约束邻居，非法响铃保留旧值的自身查询使分支数至多 M+1。由 |K|(M+1)^n T^n/n! 排除无限回溯；不宣称重建一般无限粒子系统的全部分析理论。

4G04.scope: 详细平衡及 D=sum mu(c Var_x) 的有限求和证明；无限格只对局部函数作有限非零项计算。

4G05.scope: 有限乘积的方差分解与归纳张量化；局部函数的无限乘积版本由有限支撑归约。

4G06.scope: 定义谱隙与 Poincare 常数；有限可逆链的均方衰减等价性、有限通信图的显式正谱隙界、无约束热浴常数一。无限格只给局部函数变分定义。

4G07.scope: 杀死半群、加权 Cauchy–Schwarz 和尾积分完整证明有限状态命中界；无限 KCM 界仅引用 (1.4)。

4G08.scope: 定义有限/无限自举闭包；证明单调性、幂等性、有限见证以及内部填满含义。

4G09.scope: 全占据边界的有限区域：闭包在合法翻转下不变，共同闭包给出通信路径，条件乘积测度可逆；明确有限翻转不等于无限构形的整体连通。

4G0A.scope: 定义填满与多项式尾阈值，耦合/平移论证 q_c≤tilde q_c；两阈值相等保留猜想。

4G0B.scope: 精确陈述 Theorem 1.4 的严格阈值区间、L2 遍历性与有限松弛结论；不加入临界端点结论。

4G0C.scope: 完整列出内部填满概率趋一、局部详细平衡和全闭包支撑；引用唯一性与 FA-1f 平稳态分类，不重建熵/有限窗口极限证明。

4G0D.scope: 局部固定整数 d≥1、0<q<1，记录按自举稳定构形分解的猜想；正概率条件测度和零概率分量的额外构造严格分开。

4G0E.scope: East 有向规则、冻结半线与自举尾界 (1-q)^(n+1)；由定义得到两个自举阈值为零，再调用已标明来源的遍历定理。

4G0F.scope: ell(n)=2^n-1 与对数主阶可达构形上界按报告引用；只对 n=1,2 给出直接路径解释，不宣称一般组合证明。正半轴空位总数含目标空位。

4G0G.scope: 引用固定维数的精确极限 1/(2d log 2)，说明能量/熵及低温变量的代数关系；不把启发式计数当作定理证明。

4G0H.scope: 有限链的最坏初态全变差距离、混合时间和截断窗口；基础全变差定义复用 4F27，不再证明其基本性质。

4G0I.scope: 保留有限方盒、原点空其余外边界占据、固定 q 后 L 趋无穷及适用 q 区间；一维全 q 与 sqrt(L) 窗口作为源备注。 全变差定义链接 4F27，最坏初态距离/截断定义链接 4G0H。

4G0J.scope: d≥2、0<q<1；有向 Poisson 路径计数证明固定有限时间的加厚感染集几乎必然为非空紧集。Hausdorff 距离复用 00FN，极限 K 明确为非空紧集。形状收敛仍是较弱的概率距离猜想，不声称等价于原文强集合夹逼或已证明。

4G0K.scope: 定义 k 空位促进；FA-1f 两步移动及有限连通区域非空空位类的通信性直接证明。

4G0L.scope: 二维 FA-2f 有限感染集不能越出包围矩形；两条相邻全占据无限线形成屏障，有限与无限情形分别说明。

4G0M.scope: 引用 d=1 的 q^-3、d≥3 的 q^-2 及 d=2 上下界；独立游走启发式明确为距离平方除以跳跃率尺度，即 (q^(-1/d))^2/q，不作为完整证明。

4G0N.scope: 二维 log(1/q)/q^2 精细尺度明确为报告猜想，不与现有双边不等式混同。

4G0O.scope: 任意非空初态的 FA-1f 局部收敛仍为猜想；指数收敛只按补充文献的一维指数空区间尾假设陈述。

4G0P.scope: 一维 East 平稳态混合的穷尽性引用补充 Theorem 2.12；逐坐标验证候选测度可逆，并算 L omega_0(allzero)=p 排除全空点质量。

4G0Q.scope: 有限无向简单图 BABP 生成元逐项计算 L_B D=L_C D，有限矩阵半群推出自对偶；不宣称无限图全体初态的对偶延拓。

4G0R.scope: 引用二维平稳 FA-2f 命中时间均值与高概率双边精确界，并作 q log 极限；不推出尚开放的同常数松弛时间渐近。

4G0S.scope: 有限图上成对条件重抽构造、三类非空二值概率及详细平衡直接验证；有效液滴动力学的适用性并未据此证明。

4G0U.scope: 二维半圆分类精确定义，q_c 的零/正二分作为报告引入的 BP 研究结果；不补写未知阈值常数。

remaining_branches.scope: Stable-direction definition and East/FA examples covered. Do not reproduce Theorem 3.4(1)'s printed extra 1/q in the exponent; a complete corrected general statement awaits checking the cited monograph.

remaining_branches.branch: Fine critical classification and higher dimensions
remaining_branches.scope: 4G0Z records the exact double-log exponent consequence only. Seven critical classes and their logarithmic corrections, arbitrary d≥3 universality and sharp subcritical thresholds not expanded.
Theorem 4.2's infinite percolation-cluster constraint and its approximation argument are not developed; the authored construction uses finite-range constraints.
Threshold equality, general closure-component stationary decomposition, East shape, two-dimensional FA-1f logarithmic correction and FA-1f nonequilibrium convergence remain explicitly conjectural.
Sharp stationary hitting-time result is represented; equality of the leading relaxation-time constant with pi^2/9 is not asserted.
Kob–Andersen lattice gases, upper-triangular matrix walks, surface dynamics and quantum-spin-chain applications in the introduction are contextual, not additional developed branches.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Infinite-volume ergodicity, invariant-measure entropy/finite-window arguments and the exhaustiveness of stationary-state classifications are cited. Local detailed balance and candidate verification are separately proved.
General East combinatorial barrier/counting, sharp low-temperature gap and finite-box cutoff research proofs are not reconstructed.
FA-1f sharp dimension-dependent gap, FA-2f droplet rarity and multiscale conditional Poincare/matryoshka proofs remain cited inputs; the log-scale composition lemma is local and conditional.

General BP threshold/difficulty theorems and two-dimensional KCM universality, Duarte bottlenecks and hierarchical liquid-droplet motion are not reproved. Explicit stable-direction examples are local.

Propositions 4.4–4.5, including conditional random-path selection, renormalization and congestion control, are cited with exact usable assumptions; only finite deterministic reductions and abstract path comparison are proved locally.
The infinite-volume stationary hitting bound is quoted from (1.4); the complete killed-semigroup argument supplied in the note has finite state space.

metadata.model_conventions: 0=vacant/infected, 1=occupied, p=1-q; each site attempts at rate one. D=sum mu(c Var_x). Finite-volume local proofs are explicitly separated from cited infinite-volume results. Mean hitting time, high-probability hitting scale, relaxation and mixing are not identified. Effective-droplet descriptions are heuristic unless a stated conditional inequality applies.
metadata.coverage: All four main report sections represented by definitions, usable research statements, conjectures and accessible proofs. Deferred one-dimensional general formula, seven-class refinement, nonlocal percolation example and introduction-only applications listed explicitly.
metadata.shared_integration: Parent-owned; no shared trees, landing pages, registries, workflows, theme, build or git changes.
repaired_findings: Parent: 4G07 first Cauchy–Schwarz use links 004S; 4G01 defines matrix exponential; 4G06 supplies weighted inner product and norm.

source_records.title: Long time behaviour of one facilitated kinetically constrained models: results and open problems
source_records.actual_reading: Abstract and §§1.1–1.4; §2 main statements through Conjecture 3 (HTML lines 41–236), including Corollary 2.9 and Theorems 2.10/2.12. Selected §2.1 entropy-proof paragraphs and the start of §2.2 were read through approximately line 340; these sections and the whole paper were not read in full.
source_records.proof_boundary: Used for exact normalization, stationary-state theorem contracts and dimension/tail hypotheses of conjectures. Deep proofs remain cited. This is a separate paper, not an arXiv version of the assigned report.

source_records.actual_reading: Finite-state probability/energy identities, elementary closure and geometry arguments, finite-graph duality and conditional log-scale calculations are proved in the authored notes; existing forest definitions supply the prerequisite vocabulary.
source_records.proof_boundary: The finite numerical and exhaustive checks corroborate these formulas; they do not replace proofs or establish infinite-volume research results.

source_clarifications.resolution: Primary source is the DOI-bound publisher edition, published 2026-07-13 and read 2026-10-22. No exact arXiv edition located. The separate 2510.20461v1 supplement is not relabeled as this report.

4G09 proves closure/communication equivalence only in finite volume with fully occupied exterior. It does not identify infinite configurations differing at infinitely many sites by finite flip sequences.

4G0D separates ordinary positive-probability conditioning from unspecified zero-probability closure components. A regular conditional law only defined mu-almost everywhere cannot canonically determine arbitrary stationary mixing measures.

4G0J uses thickened lattice cells, includes the origin, and proves fixed-time almost-sure nonempty compactness by a Poisson path-count bound. The limiting K is explicitly nonempty compact. Hausdorff distance is reused from 00FN; the shape assertion remains the weaker Hausdorff-in-probability conjecture, not the source's stronger inclusion statement.
4G0O pins exponential convergence with exponential empty-interval tails to the one-dimensional Conjecture 2 in the fixed supplement.

Duarte log^4/q^2 estimate is stated for the stationary mean as in the source passage. General critical universality is used only for its high-probability double-log exponent, without upgrading one source's mean estimate or inventing seven-class log factors.
Sharp pi^2/9 stationary hitting time does not determine the sharp relaxation-time constant. 4G07 preserves the one-sided comparison.
4G12 defines the exterior condition without a vague universal smallness theorem; 4G13 and 4G15 give the precise smallness hypothesis from the usable Propositions 4.4–4.5.
Both the formulas and explanation in 4G15 assert upper bounds only. No optimality or matching lower bound for the comparison cost is inferred.
4G03 includes the updated coordinate's pre-ring value when a ring is illegal. With M constraint neighbors the backward branching bound is M+1, retaining the factorial ordered-time bound.
4G0W/4G0X/4G0Y each locally fix iid vacancy density q through mu_q=Bernoulli(1-q) product and the low-density limit. Discrete bootstrap infection and continuous KCM hitting times remain separate.

source_errata.issue: The conditional-variance sum carries an extra 1/2 relative to the stated heat-bath generator.
source_errata.evidence: 4G04 expands -mu(fLf) directly; supplement equation (1.6) has the conditional-variance sum without 1/2.
source_errata.resolution: D=sum_x mu(c_x Var_x); the half belongs to the oriented-edge squared-difference form.

source_errata.issue: The point mass at the fully empty configuration is listed as if it were stationary for East.
source_errata.evidence: L omega_0(allzero)=p>0 in 4G0P; supplement Theorem 2.12 identifies the fully unblocked component's stationary law as the Bernoulli product law.
source_errata.resolution: Use the product law, the fully occupied point mass, and the explicit leftmost-vacancy laws; import only the classification's exhaustiveness.

source_errata.issue: The printed exponent contains log^2(1/q)/q, inconsistent with the East example and Theorem 2.2.
source_errata.evidence: Theorem 3.4 explicitly includes East and says the analogous scale holds for relaxation, while Theorem 2.2 gives square-log relaxation.
source_errata.resolution: Do not state a corrected general one-dimensional universality theorem without checking the cited monograph. Retain the exact East theorem and stable-direction definition.

source_errata.issue: The relevant count is indexed by the vacancy budget n of order log_2(1/q), not by the spacing 1/q. Exact small-n counts also depend on whether the initial empty set is included.
source_errata.evidence: 4G0F defines V_n including the initial state and quotes only the logarithmic leading counting bound.
source_errata.resolution: Keep ell(n)=2^n-1 as cited; use log|V_n|≤(n^2/2)log 2+O(n log(n+1)). No incorrect exact finite-n counting bound asserted.

source_errata.issue: One qualitative sentence prints a sqrt(q) exponent where the surrounding inverse-root scale diverges.
source_errata.evidence: The precise displayed conditional Poincare estimate (2.6) gives exp(O(log^3(1/q)/sqrt(q))).
source_errata.resolution: 4G18 uses only that explicit quantitative input and proves its subleading status algebraically.

section_coverage.scope: Clock construction, finite generator background, update families, closure thresholds and exact finite multistate projection.

Oriented rule, barriers, sharp relaxation, finite-box cutoff, explicitly conjectural shape and supplement-corrected stationary measures.
Single-vacancy mobility, dimension-dependent relaxation, open logarithmic/nonequilibrium problems and a complete finite-graph BABP duality calculation.
Cooperative obstruction, sharp stationary hitting theorem, generalized CBSEP and conditional subleading-cost lemma; full matryoshka proof remains external.

Stable directions, half-circle classification, difficulty, concrete calculations, rooted dichotomy and critical double-log exponent. General 1D numerical typo and seven-class refinement are not silently filled in.
Finite bottleneck and canonical-path proofs, exterior definition/counterexample, exact Propositions 4.4–4.5 with all event/variance conventions, and a complete finite deterministic-path reduction.

remaining_branches.scope: Stable-direction definition and East/FA examples covered. Do not reproduce Theorem 3.4(1)'s printed extra 1/q in the exponent; a complete corrected general statement awaits checking the cited monograph.

remaining_branches.branch: Fine critical classification and higher dimensions
remaining_branches.scope: 4G0Z records the exact double-log exponent consequence only. Seven critical classes and their logarithmic corrections, arbitrary d≥3 universality and sharp subcritical thresholds not expanded.
Theorem 4.2's infinite percolation-cluster constraint and its approximation argument are not developed; the authored construction uses finite-range constraints.
Threshold equality, general closure-component stationary decomposition, East shape, two-dimensional FA-1f logarithmic correction and FA-1f nonequilibrium convergence remain explicitly conjectural.
Sharp stationary hitting-time result is represented; equality of the leading relaxation-time constant with pi^2/9 is not asserted.
Kob–Andersen lattice gases, upper-triangular matrix walks, surface dynamics and quantum-spin-chain applications in the introduction are contextual, not additional developed branches.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Infinite-volume ergodicity, invariant-measure entropy/finite-window arguments and the exhaustiveness of stationary-state classifications are cited. Local detailed balance and candidate verification are separately proved.
General East combinatorial barrier/counting, sharp low-temperature gap and finite-box cutoff research proofs are not reconstructed.
FA-1f sharp dimension-dependent gap, FA-2f droplet rarity and multiscale conditional Poincare/matryoshka proofs remain cited inputs; the log-scale composition lemma is local and conditional.

General BP threshold/difficulty theorems and two-dimensional KCM universality, Duarte bottlenecks and hierarchical liquid-droplet motion are not reproved. Explicit stable-direction examples are local.

Propositions 4.4–4.5, including conditional random-path selection, renormalization and congestion control, are cited with exact usable assumptions; only finite deterministic reductions and abstract path comparison are proved locally.
The infinite-volume stationary hitting bound is quoted from (1.4); the complete killed-semigroup argument supplied in the note has finite state space.
